clue.text: Writer considered advice accompanying enclosure

parts.note: to have felt something is to have considered or judged it so
a tip is a piece of advice
a pen is an enclosure for animals

explanation.surface: A writer weighs up some advice that came with an enclosure in the post.
explanation.definitionFit: This kind of marker is an implement that writes, so it is a writer in the sense of a tool.

clue.text: Eastern sea creature shedding tail in spring

indicators.note: shedding its tail means the last letter of the sea creature is dropped

parts.note: a manatee is a sea cow, a large marine mammal

explanation.surface: An eastern marine animal loses its tail during the springtime.
explanation.definitionFit: To spring from a source is to issue or flow out from it, the verb's core sense.

clue.text: Awkward drunk

definitions.meaning: a ... spot is an awkward or difficult one

explanation.definitionFit: Both senses are standard: a tight situation is awkward, and someone tight has had too much alcohol.

clue.text: One certain to reform very quickly

parts.note: one is the Roman numeral I

indicators.note: to reform is to reshape, so the letters are put into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone sure to mend their ways describes a reformed sinner.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means in an instant, so it is a phrase for doing something very fast.

clue.text: Pioneer's wagon — plain sailing in it?

definitions.meaning: a covered wagon of the American settlers heading west
a prairie is a plain and a schooner a sailing ship, so the vehicle sails over the plains

explanation.definitionFit: The covered wagons used by settlers crossing the American plains were given this nickname for their white canvas tops like sails.

clue.text: Drink in a mug

definitions.meaning: a small measure of liquor, about a quarter pint
mug is slang for the face or head, as is this word

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both a small quantity of alcohol and, informally, a person's head, a sense shared with mug.

clue.text: Finish second best

parts.note: top means best or first-rate

explanation.surface: Someone comes in runner-up in a race.
explanation.definitionFit: To finish something is to bring it to a halt, a plain synonym.

clue.text: One giving roadside assistance? Versatile AA man's beginning to repair it

indicators.note: versatile suggests something that can turn many ways, so these letters are rearranged
the beginning of the word repair is its first letter

explanation.surface: A breakdown patrolman from the Automobile Association, being versatile, starts to fix it.
explanation.walkthrough: The AA is the Automobile Association, the British breakdown service. The surface points at a mechanic, but the definition is the Good Samaritan of the parable, who helped a traveller by the road.
explanation.definitionFit: In the parable the Good Samaritan stopped to help a man lying injured by the road, so he is a roadside helper.

clue.text: Eccentric hoarding silver? Shock horror!

indicators.note: hoarding means keeping something stored inside, so one piece holds the other

parts.note: outré means unconventional or eccentric
Ag is the chemical symbol for silver

explanation.surface: An oddball has been stockpiling silver, to general dismay.
explanation.definitionFit: The exclamation expresses indignation, which is a feeling of strong offence or scandal.

clue.text: Kick out guru's initial report

parts.note: to ban someone is to bar or exclude them

indicators.note: the initial of the word guru's is its first letter

explanation.surface: A news story on a spiritual teacher's opening move to expel someone.
explanation.definitionFit: A report is a loud noise such as a gunshot, and this word names such a sound.

clue.text: Compound in Malaga demolished by friend

indicators.note: a demolished building is knocked down and rebuilt, so these letters are rearranged

parts.note: mate is informal for a friend

explanation.surface: A friend knocks down a walled compound in the Spanish city of Málaga.
explanation.definitionFit: To compound things is to combine or merge them, the verb sense of the word.

clue.text: Female to change flag

parts.note: to alter is to change

explanation.surface: A woman decides to change the national banner.
explanation.definitionFit: To flag is to tire or weaken, and to waver or lose strength is a close synonym.

clue.text: Complain next to bar about article 18

parts.note: to rail is to complain bitterly

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the bar goes round the article

parts.note: a rod is a bar of metal or wood
a is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: Someone grumbles beside a pub counter about a newspaper article.
explanation.walkthrough: 18 points to the answer of 18-down, DRAGOON, used as a verb meaning to force someone into something.
explanation.definitionFit: To dragoon someone and to push them through are both senses of coercing a person without regard to objections.

clue.text: A nettle waving about caught arm

indicators.note: about means around, so the shuffled letters surround the abbreviation
waving suggests movement back and forth, so these letters are shuffled

parts.note: C is the cricket abbreviation for caught

explanation.surface: A stinging plant swaying in the wind brushes against someone's arm.
explanation.walkthrough: 'waving' turns A NETTLE into TENTALE, and 'about' puts C inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: An octopus's arm is one of these flexible limbs, so arm is a direct synonym.

clue.text: Williams, say, showing remarkable net sense by middle of set

indicators.note: remarkable here hints that the letters are re-marked, rearranged into a new order
the middle of the word set is its central letter

explanation.surface: A tennis player called Williams shows great court sense at the net in the middle of a set.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface suggests the tennis Williams sisters, but the definition is the playwright Tennessee Williams, the 'say' marking an example of someone with that first name.
explanation.definitionFit: The American playwright Williams bore this first name, so Williams is an example of a person called so.

clue.text: Row in Italian river, avoiding middle

indicators.note: avoiding the middle means the central letter of the river is left out

parts.note: the Tiber flows through Rome

explanation.surface: Someone rows on a river in Italy, keeping away from midstream.
explanation.definitionFit: A row of seats in a stadium or theatre is one of these levels or ranks.

clue.text: Sibyl supporting dock painter

indicators.note: in a down answer the supporting piece sits below, so the prophet comes after

parts.note: to dock a ship is to bring it to land
a sibyl was a prophetess, a seer

explanation.surface: A prophetess lends her backing to the dock workers.
explanation.walkthrough: Sir Edwin Landseer was a Victorian painter of animals, known for the lions in Trafalgar Square.
explanation.definitionFit: Landseer was an English artist famous for his paintings of animals, so painter defines him.

clue.text: Former PM, first to enter study

indicators.note: the first of the word enter is its opening letter

parts.note: a den is a private room for study

explanation.surface: An ex-prime minister is the first to walk into the library.
explanation.walkthrough: Anthony Eden was British Prime Minister from 1955 to 1957.
explanation.definitionFit: Anthony Eden held the office of British Prime Minister in the 1950s, so he is a past premier.

clue.text: Watchful woman filled with love for cavalryman

indicators.note: filled with means the other piece goes inside

parts.note: a dragon is a fierce, vigilant woman, such as a chaperone
love is zero in tennis, shaped like O

explanation.surface: A vigilant woman is full of affection for a mounted soldier.
explanation.definitionFit: Dragoons were mounted infantry, soldiers who rode horses into battle.

clue.text: Power tool was returned after row

indicators.note: after puts the reversed word behind the row

parts.note: a chain is a series or row of linked things

indicators.note: returned means read back to front

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A power tool was handed back after an argument.
explanation.definitionFit: A motor-driven saw with teeth on a chain is a power tool used for cutting wood.

clue.text: A job extremely lucrative for James, perhaps

parts.note: a post is a job or position

indicators.note: extremely points to the extremes of the word lucrative, its first and last letters

explanation.surface: Somebody named James has a highly paid job.
explanation.definitionFit: James was one of the twelve disciples of Jesus, so he is an example of one.

clue.text: Location, reportedly, for flatfish

indicators.note: reportedly means as heard, so a word that sounds like this is wanted

parts.note: a place is a location

explanation.surface: A news report says where to find flatfish.
explanation.definitionFit: This is a common European flatfish with orange spots, eaten widely in Britain.

clue.text: Transport to a lower station

indicators.note: to transport is to carry somewhere else, so the following letters are moved into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone is carried down to a station on a lower level.
explanation.definitionFit: This is one of London's main railway termini, so a station is the class it belongs to.

clue.text: Fuming about boy in fruit tree

indicators.note: about means turned round, so the word is reversed

parts.note: to be mad is to be furious, fuming
a son is a boy

explanation.surface: Someone is angry about a boy up an orchard tree.
explanation.definitionFit: This small plum is the fruit of a particular tree, and the name also covers the tree.

clue.text: How one may address a woman from the north or the south?

definitions.text: How one may address a woman

indicators.text: from the north or the south
indicators.note: in a down answer read from top or bottom, the letters spell the same word both ways

parts.words: How one may address a woman
parts.note: these definition words give the whole answer, and the answer is itself the palindrome: it reads the same from either end

explanation.surface: A polite form of address applies whether the woman is a northerner or a southerner.
explanation.definitionFit: This is the formal courtesy title used when speaking to a woman, as in a shop or letter.

clue.text: Conservative on discipline and morals

indicators.note: on means placed next to in an across answer, here before

parts.note: a science is a branch of knowledge, a discipline

explanation.surface: A Tory politician lectures on discipline and moral standards.
explanation.definitionFit: The inner sense of right and wrong is a person's moral sense, so morals stands for it.

clue.text: Information — a small amount sent over

indicators.note: sent over suggests flipping, so the word is reversed

parts.note: a tad is a small amount

explanation.surface: A small piece of information is sent across.
explanation.definitionFit: These are facts and figures, so it is a synonym for information.

clue.text: Formerly working with church

parts.note: on means functioning or working, as a switched-on machine
CE stands for Church of England

explanation.surface: Someone used to work for the church.
explanation.definitionFit: Something done at one time in the past was done formerly, a close synonym.

clue.text: Hearing piece produced by organ and wind instrument

parts.note: the ear is the organ of hearing
a trumpet is a brass wind instrument

explanation.surface: A piece of music is played on an organ and a brass instrument.
explanation.definitionFit: This horn-shaped device is held to the ear to amplify sound, an old hearing aid.
